# sealit (v0.0.1)

> Zero-dependency verification CLI and agent skill suite for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Antigravity, GitHub Copilot) across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and self-hosted Git—enforcing branch/worktree session isolation, Spec/ADR drift alignment, measured diff coverage & mutation gates, and HMAC-SHA256 merge receipts.

## Core Documentation

- [README.md](./README.md): PR lifecycle, two-track installation, agent prompt guide, and 18-command CLI reference
- [PRODUCT.md](./PRODUCT.md): Constitutional invariants, capability matrix (`CAP-01`..`CAP-06`), and ADR index
- [GLOSSARY.md](./GLOSSARY.md): Domain vocabulary for sessions, public seams, drift, and merge receipts
- [docs/PRD.md](./docs/PRD.md): Product Requirements Document (`v0.0.1`)
- [docs/SRS.md](./docs/SRS.md): Software Requirements Specification & compacted ADR lineage
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md): Local setup, TDD workflow, and pull request verification checklist
- [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md): Semantic Versioning release history

## Capability Specifications (`docs/specs/`)

- [docs/specs/cap-01-git-and-worktree-guard.md](./docs/specs/cap-01-git-and-worktree-guard.md): Protected-branch Git Flow, linked-worktree hygiene & Git hooks
- [docs/specs/cap-02-config-and-shell-free-execution.md](./docs/specs/cap-02-config-and-shell-free-execution.md): Schema-validated `.agent/sealit-config.json` & shell-free `execFileSync` execution
- [docs/specs/cap-03-spec-adr-and-ring-alignment.md](./docs/specs/cap-03-spec-adr-and-ring-alignment.md): Spec/manifest/OpenAPI drift, human-approved ADRs & optional layer boundary checks
- [docs/specs/cap-04-single-path-measured-gate.md](./docs/specs/cap-04-single-path-measured-gate.md): Single-path (`docs-only` vs `code`) coverage, mutation & secret-scan gate
- [docs/specs/cap-05-cryptographic-merge-receipts.md](./docs/specs/cap-05-cryptographic-merge-receipts.md): Append-only SHA-256 hash chain & multi-topology HMAC-SHA256 merge receipts
- [docs/specs/cap-06-canonical-skills-and-installer.md](./docs/specs/cap-06-canonical-skills-and-installer.md): Canonical 6-skill suite, symlink-safe multi-agent installer & `doctor`
